description_en: Queries the settings of the automatic primary/secondary switchover feature for an instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询RDS实例主备自动切换的设置
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-ha-switch-config --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeHASwitchConfig

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.name: region_id

HAConfig.description_en:
The status of the automatic primary/secondary switchover feature. Valid values:

Auto: The automatic primary/secondary switchover feature is enabled. The system automatically switches your workloads over from the instance to its secondary instance in the event of a fault.
Manual: The automatic primary/secondary switchover feature is temporarily disabled
HAConfig.description_zh:
主备自动切换设置，取值：
Auto：出现故障时自动切换主备实例。
Manual：已临时关闭自动切换

ManualHATime.description_en: The time when the automatic primary/secondary switchover feature is enabled again. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
ManualHATime.description_zh: 临时关闭截止时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
